title: 1-1/2 in. SHOCKWAVE Impact Duty 1/2 in. Drive Deep Well 6-Point Impact Socket
description:
The MILWAUKEE TOOL - 49-66-6238 is a Deep Impact Socket, an indispensable tool in the tools and machining industry. This hand tool is specifically designed to apply high torque to nuts or bolts using an impact wrench. Its deep design allows it to accommodate long threads or protruding fasteners, making it ideal for heavy-duty applications.
Key features of this product include:

  • Made from durable steel material.

  • Deep socket depth designed for accommodating long threads or protruding fasteners.

  • Non-magnetic and non-sparking, adding versatility in various work environments.

  • Compliant with standard specifications ensuring compatibility with other tools or equipment.

  • Specific socket size and length tailored for high-torque applications.

  • Impact rated, indicating its ability to withstand high levels of force from an impact wrench.

  • Tether ready feature allowing secure attachment when needed.
    This Deep Impact Socket has a socket size of 1 1/2 in, a drive type impact, and a drive size of 1/2 in. It's compatible with adapters, drivers, ratchets, wrenches. The socket depth is deep while the overall length measures at 3 5/64 inches.
